tools.name: browse_collections
tools.description: List themed Cornish Secrets holiday cottage collections (dog-friendly, romantic, large-party, etc.) or open a specific collection when a slug is supplied.

slug.description: Optional collection slug. Omit to get the collections hub URL.

tools.name: browse_destinations
tools.description: List Cornwall destinations Cornish Secrets curates cottages for, or open a specific destination page when a slug is supplied (e.g. "padstow", "st-ives").

slug.description: Optional destination slug. Omit to get the destinations hub URL.

tools.name: get_llms_guidance
tools.description: Fetch the Cornish Secrets llms.txt — the canonical list of pages preferred for AI grounding plus user-intent routing rules.

tools.name: search_cottages
tools.description: Search Cornish Secrets for Cornwall holiday cottages by free-text query (places, attributes, sleeps). Returns the search results URL plus the top matches from the WordPress REST API.

query.description: Free-text search query, e.g. "padstow", "dog friendly", "sea views sleeps 6".
